title: The Wow! Signal Just Got a Twin

vo.text: The famous Wow Signal was never an alien broadcast.
vo.imagePrompt: Massive radio telescope dish at night under a starry sky, glowing neon red indicator lights, cinematic sci-fi lighting

vo.text: It was just neutral hydrogen singing in deep space.
vo.imagePrompt: Glowing blue hydrogen atom radiating cosmic waves through dark outer space, highly detailed 3d render

vo.text: In 1977, astronomers detected a seventy-two second burst that stumped science.
vo.imagePrompt: Vintage computer monitor displaying glowing red numbers and text in a dark observatory, 1970s aesthetics

vo.text: It sat perfectly at the natural frequency of neutral hydrogen.
vo.imagePrompt: Abstract audio wave graph pulsing at 1420 Megahertz against a starry void, crisp cyan lines

vo.text: Pause right now and guess where it came from.
vo.imagePrompt: Deep space star field with a glowing yellow target reticle focusing on an empty dark sector

vo.text: Comets. Solar flares hitting hydrogen clouds caused a natural cosmic laser.
vo.imagePrompt: A massive icy comet passing through an intense glowing solar flare, spewing brilliant blue gas

vo.text: Then astronomers found its identical twin signal eighteen hundred light-years away.
vo.imagePrompt: Two identical glowing golden signal beams crossing deep space from distant star clusters

vo.text: Originating from absolute void with no comets in sight.
vo.imagePrompt: Eerie dark void of deep space with distant faint galaxies, pitch black emptiness, atmospheric photo
